_note: Model routing for the AI-shaped touchpoints that read free-form user context (business context, Ask Atlas queries, unparsed scenario moves). Three tiers, by how costly a wrong read is: low (closed classification, one right answer), medium (bounded structured extraction — today's existing default), high (open interpretation, vision, or synthesis).
_basis: Only used when a caller passes AiRequest.tier — the 7 pre-existing AI call sites omit it and keep using aiModel()'s single default exactly as before. OpenAI's high tier is held at the same model as medium deliberately: unlike Anthropic's family, there isn't yet a confidently-safe 'next tier up' id to pin without risking a request that 404s on an account this hasn't been tested against.
